limitations: Independent model and GLB readback only; no visual reference similarity assertion.
Loop velocity is a one-sided 120 Hz finite-difference check, not proof of analytic C1 continuity.

tolerances.rationale: Finite differences spanning adjacent exported 120 Hz samples allow 25 mm/s linear and 0.10 rad/s angular seam mismatch; values and vectors are reported, so this does not hide exact continuity residuals.
